task: Report per-source chunk coverage in the knowledge-base search tool response, using an Elasticsearch aggregation total that was previously discarded, plus a notice telling the model to re-query rather than invent missing content.

component_scope.label: M
component_scope.affected: SearchAndRerankKB (search/rerank service), SearchKBTool (knowledge-base agent tool), their unit test suites

requirements_clarity.label: L
requirements_clarity.gaps: Coverage is derived from indexed chunk counts rather than retrievable chunk counts; the discrepancy is known and deferred by explicit user decision. A second planned item (block-boundary truncation in conversation history replay) was specified, implemented, then found to be a net regression that could drop all document content, and was reverted - the requirement rested on an assumption that did not survive review.

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Model-facing text on a shared tool used by every knowledge-base datasource, so a wrong coverage claim propagates to every KB-backed agent; no prior precedent in the codebase for a coverage/completeness statement; an absent or malformed totals map must degrade to 'not verified' rather than silently imply completeness; notice placement matters because downstream token reducers cut from the tail.
technical_risk.mitigation: isinstance guard on the totals map so a missing total yields an explicit unverified notice instead of an invented claim; coverage lines and notices emitted ahead of content so tail truncation cannot strip the guardrail; two full code-review rounds (4 blocking findings, one critical, plus a fifth caught in the check round); change is pure formatting with no persistence, so rollback is trivial.

key_reasoning.reason: Diff is small but the surface is high-leverage: format_response emits text the LLM reads on every knowledge-base retrieval across all datasources. Review surfaced 4 blocking findings (one critical) in round one and a fifth in the check round - notably that the unverified path originally shipped without any notice, which is exactly the case where completeness cannot be vouched for, and that a trailing notice is the first thing lost to tail-cutting token reducers. No precedent for this pattern existed in the codebase.

Rework materialised rather than merely being a risk: the block-boundary truncation task was implemented per plan, judged a net regression capable of dropping all document content, and reverted - real effort that leaves no trace in the final diff. A known semantic gap (indexed vs retrievable chunk totals) remains open by explicit user decision.

Two components in a producer/consumer handoff: SearchAndRerankKB records source_chunk_totals from the existing routing aggregation (including sources it excludes from routing), and SearchKBTool consumes it defensively. The consumer is a tool shared by every knowledge-base datasource, so the blast radius exceeds the two files.
4 files, roughly 95 insertions, no new files - but spread across two production subsystems and their mirrored test directories.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from S to M: touches a core shared utility - the search_kb tool is the single retrieval surface for every knowledge-base datasource, so wording correctness carried weight beyond the two files changed.

Requirements Clarity bumped from M to L: unresolved semantics deferred by explicit decision (coverage counted from indexed rather than retrievable chunks) combined with a planned item whose underlying assumption failed review and was reverted.
